rules.name: ouat142-inputs-extract
rules.sql: SELECT * FROM opera.vol_id_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND expiry_date >= (SELECT CAST(min(g) AS date) FROM (SELECT g FROM generate_series(CAST(:settleDate AS date) - 10, CAST(:settleDate AS date) - 1, interval '1 day') AS g WHERE extract(isodow FROM g) < 6 ORDER BY g DESC LIMIT 3) t) ORDER BY bbg_opt_ticker, vol_id DESC
SELECT invenio_product_code, option_tick_size FROM opera.product_master_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND asset_class NOT IN ('index', 'currency', 'bond', 'money market')
SELECT *, TRIM(product_code) || ' ' AS product_code_space FROM opera.marketdata_option_conv_table
SELECT query_code FROM opera.matlab_query_table WHERE query_unique_name = 'option_maturity'

SELECT bbg_underlying_id, invenio_product_code FROM opera.underlying_list_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND expiry_date >= CAST(:settleDate AS date) AND bbg_underlying_id IS NOT NULL AND bbg_underlying_id <> '' ORDER BY bbg_underlying_id, expiry_date

SELECT ul.underlying_id, ul.bbg_underlying_id, sv.settle_value, ul.expiry_date FROM opera.underlying_list_table ul LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT underlying_id, settle_value FROM opera.underlying_settle_value_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND settlement_date = CAST(:settleDate AS date)) sv ON sv.underlying_id = ul.underlying_id WHERE ul.tenant_id = :tenant AND ul.asset_class NOT IN ('bond', 'commodity index swap', 'currency', 'equity', 'equity_swaps', 'index', 'money market') AND ul.expiry_date >= CAST(:settleDate AS date)
